context: Evaluates correct implementation of intraday technical indicator computation as provided by the open-nof1.ai package. The solution must correctly fetch 1-minute OHLCV data from Binance futures and compute EMA-20, MACD, RSI-7, RSI-14 series and mid-prices using the last 10 candles of a 100-candle fetch window.

checklist.name: 1-minute OHLCV fetch
checklist.description: The solution fetches 1-minute timeframe OHLCV data from the Binance perpetual futures exchange using the CCXT binance instance configured in open-nof1.ai (fetching ~100 candles)

checklist.name: Mid-prices computation
checklist.description: Mid-prices are correctly computed as the average of the high and low of each candle, and the last 10 values are returned

checklist.name: EMA-20 series
checklist.description: EMA-20 is computed using the technicalindicators EMA class and the last 10 values of the result are returned as an array

checklist.name: MACD series
checklist.description: MACD is computed using the technicalindicators MACD class and the last 10 MACD values are returned as an array

checklist.name: RSI-7 series
checklist.description: 7-period RSI is computed using the technicalindicators RSI class and the last 10 values are returned in the rsi_7 array

checklist.name: RSI-14 series
checklist.description: 14-period RSI is computed using the technicalindicators RSI class and the last 10 values are returned in the rsi_14 array
